purpose: Leakage-controlled evaluation index; scoring data remains in data/exams and benchmark result files.
grouping_rule: All subquestions and near-duplicate variants from one exam stay together.
held_out_policy: Do not include reference answers or retrieved solutions in prompts.
Freeze prompt, model, schema, and solver configuration before scoring.
Report missing source images, uncertain OCR, and not_checkable proofs explicitly.
limitations: Some exam JSON records are transcribed_needs_review rather than independently proofread.
The repository does not contain a gold image transcription for every question.
The split is exam-level but small; it is not a population estimate of generalization.
